name: @ghost-bot/desktop
description: Ghost Bot local-first desktop AI workspace

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/bundle-daemon.mjs
scripts.package:appimage: pnpm build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:rpm: pnpm build && electron-builder --linux rpm --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
